I didn’t close the file with my first IS partner in 2015, I didn’t know it was a demand. . I reopened with my current partner in 2024 and it was understood the file was still open. I was  informed it was a criminal offence to leave it open.

I know you don’t think you’ll be back. 

But

Long story short, close it.
